tools.name: list_docs
tools.description: Enumerate all available docs pages, optionally filtered by product (e.g. 'compass', 'legal', 'overview'). Use this to discover what slugs exist before calling `get_doc`. No authentication required.

tools.name: prism_fields_list

tools.name: prism_nodes_expand

tools.name: prism_nodes_update

tools.description: One study's questions, response count, open/closed state, and the STORED analysis (summary + themes with strength; insights.activeRun set = an analysis is running right now — wait for it before citing). participantUrl is the live share link to forward when the study is open and one has been minted.

Stored on the study; the printable report at the study page renders it above the char

tools.description: Recurring research programs (ADR 0031): name, cadence, enabled state, next wave time, wave count, and the metric + score rule when the series posts readings. Waves themselves are ordinary studies.

tools.description: CLOSES the current wave (no more responses; it scores and posts to Ledger if bound) and fields the next one from the series' frozen instrument, readying its participant link. Raw transcript included only while no memo exists. inviteUrl is the link to forward for interviews still waiting on their guest.

tools.name: prism_studies_segments
tools.description: The stored k-means segmentation over the study's numeric answers: named segments with size, share, and the distinguishing features (segment mean vs overall). Null when none computed yet — prism_studies_segments_compute discovers them (needs 30+ responses and 2+ numeric questions).

tools.name: prism_studies_cut

tools.name: prism_studies_analyze
tools.description: Kicks the theme analysis (incremental — reads only responses and interviews since the last run; the previous themes carry forward). Returns immediately with the run's phase; the run continues server-side, so wait a moment and re-read prism_studies_get — findings are fresh once its insights stop repo

tools.name: prism_interviews_create
tools.description: Creates a one-on-one AI-led interview on a study and returns the invite link to forward — the guest needs no account. tools.name: prism_insights_promote
tools.description: Promotes an analysis theme (or, with no themeId, the analysis summary) into the workspace's Ledger as a belief, carrying the supporting verbatims as evidence with links back to the study. THE step that turns a finding into workspace memory — use when the user says an insight matters. May return `nee

tools.name: prism_studies_segments_compute
tools.description: Runs k-means over the study's numeric answers (silhouette-picked k) and names the discovered segments from their computed profiles. Needs 30+ responses and 2+ numeric questions; recompute overwrites. Runs naming against inference credit. May return `needs_confirmation`.

tools.name: prism_fields_update
tools.description: Edits a field's name (null reverts to the origin idea), description, or visibility. Nodes are untouched. Field ids come from prism_fields_list. May return `needs_confirmation`.

tools.name: prism_fields_delete
tools.description: Removes a field and its whole canvas (soft delete; frees the workspace's field quota). Use when the user is done with an exploration or one was created by mistake — studies attached to its nodes are not deleted. Field ids come from prism_fields_list. May return `needs_confirmation` — name the field

tools.name: prism_studies_list_workspace
tools.description: All studies regardless of origin — standalone, canvas-node, and series waves — newest first: title, question count, response count, draft / live / closed state, and the field / node / series it hangs off. tools.description: Permanently deletes a study with its responses, interviews, analysis, and share links. Right for a draft that won't be fielded or a duplicate; for a live study the user just wants to stop, prefer prism_studies_update closed: true — that keeps the data. Study ids come from prism_studies_list_workspac

tools.description: Creates a research program that fields the SAME instrument on a schedule — brand tracking, a weekly pulse — each wave an ordinary study. tools.description: Lists the comment threads on one workspace entity (open first, then resolved) with authors and timestamps. Read this before weighing in on contested work — the threads are where disagreement lives before it becomes a decision.

tools.description: Sets a comment thread's resolved state (rootId = the thread's root comment id). Resolve ONLY when the human asked or the thread's question is demonstrably settled — and say what settled it in a reply first. Reopening is for new evidence.

tools.description: Finds entities across every tool by name in one call — Workbench flows, Compass pages, Caliper datasets, evals, rubrics, reviews, specs and sources (apps sending agent traces), Ledger entries, Napkin sketches and decks. Use it FIRST when the user names something without saying where it lives ('the o

Use it before entity_tags_set so you replace the full set knowingly, and to answer 'what is this filed under'. Entities the user can't see are omit

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "list_docs" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "prism" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_docs, prism_studies_update, prism_series_list, prism_interviews_list, prism_series_create, comments_list, search_workspace · Private data: prism_studies_report, search_workspace · Public sink: prism_studies_get, prism_studies_draft, prism_studies_draft_standalone, prism_studies_draft_from_interviews, prism_studies_update, prism_interviews_list, prism_studies_segments, prism_studies_analyze, prism_interviews_create, prism_studies_delete · Destructive: prism_studies_results, prism_studies_analyze, prism_interviews_create, prism_fields_delete, prism_studies_delete, comments_create.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_docs, prism_studies_update, prism_series_list, prism_interviews_list, prism_series_create, comments_list, search_workspace · Private data: prism_studies_report, search_workspace · Public sink: prism_studies_get, prism_studies_draft, prism_studies_draft_standalone, prism_studies_draft_from_interviews, prism_studies_update, prism_interviews_list, prism_studies_segments, prism_studies_analyze, prism_interviews_create, prism_studies_delete · Destructive: prism_studies_results, prism_studies_analyze, prism_interviews_create, prism_fields_delete, prism_studies_delete, comments_create

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
